#Creating the heatmap 
```{r}
#zscore the data.subset1 dataset (147)
genus.padjust.subset = genus.padjust.merge[,c(2:265)]
genus.padjust.subset.transformed = asin(sqrt(genus.padjust.subset))
zscore.data.subset <- t(scale(genus.padjust.subset.transformed))

# Sidequest = a few z-scores are really high so I'm seeing where is a good place to "clip" them (i.e., change to a lower number)
all_z = as.vector(as.matrix(zscore.data.subset))

ggplot(data.frame(z = all_z), aes(x = z)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of All Z-scored Abundances",
    x = "Z-score",
    y = "Count"
  )

######### Clustering ###########
#1) Choose distance metric
our_dist_method = "euclidean"
#2)Choose clustering method
our_clust_method = "ward.D2"

#Cluster rows but not columns
set.seed(2025)
row_clust = hclust(dist(zscore.data.subset, method = our_dist_method),
                                method = our_clust_method)
row_dend = as.dendrogram(row_clust)
#Splitting clusters 
row_k = 9 

#Split into clusters
#Note: sample clusts and analyt clusts will tell you which cluster each sample/analyte is in.
microbe_cluster = cutree(row_clust, 
                         k = row_k)


#How to get name of taxa in each cluster
taxa_by_cluster = split(names(microbe_cluster), microbe_cluster)
taxa_by_cluster

                    
cluster_colors.1 = c( "salmon4", #Cluster 1 = Treated effluent
                    "black", #Cluster 2 
                    "red", #CLuster 3 
                    "steelblue", # Cluster 4
                    "orange", # Cluster 5 
                    "black", # Cluster 6
                    "black" , #Cluster 7
                    "black", #Cluster 8
                    "black") #Cluster 9

######## Getting RA sum per cluster per sample
#1) Transpose abundance matrix to match z=score
raw_RA = culled.abund.genus[, rownames(zscore.data.subset)]
raw_RA$Sample_ID = rownames(raw_RA)

raw_RA = merge(raw_RA, metadata, by.x = "Sample_ID", by.y = "Sample_ID")
rownames(raw_RA) = raw_RA$Unique.ID
raw_RA.2 = raw_RA[,c(1:146)] 

abund_matrix = t(raw_RA) 
abund_matrix.2 = abund_matrix[names(microbe_cluster), ]
abund_matrix.3 <- apply(abund_matrix.2, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(abund_matrix.3) <- rownames(abund_matrix.2)

# Compute cluster-wise sums for each sample
cluster_sums = sapply(1:row_k, function(k) {
  taxa_in_cluster = names(microbe_cluster[microbe_cluster == k])
  colSums(abund_matrix.3[taxa_in_cluster, , drop = FALSE])
})

cluster_sums = as.data.frame(cluster_sums)
colnames(cluster_sums) = paste0("Cluster_", 1:row_k)
rownames(cluster_sums) = colnames(abund_matrix.2)  # samples

#Getting row order of cluster_sums to match column order of heatmpa
cluster_sums.1 = cluster_sums[match(colnames(zscore.data.subset),
                                   rownames(cluster_sums)), , drop = FALSE]


#Cluster annotation
cluster_sum_RA =  HeatmapAnnotation(
  'Cluster Abundance' = anno_barplot(
    cluster_sums.1,
    gp = gpar(fill = cluster_colors.1, col = "black", lwd = 0.1),
    border = T,
    height = unit(3, "cm"),
    bar_width = 0.9,
    axis_param = list(side = "left")
  )
)



# Dendrogram colors by cluster
#Setting cluster colors

cluster_colors.2 = c( "orange", #Cluster 1 
                    "red",   # Cluster 2 
                    "salmon4",       # Cluster 3 
                    "steelblue", #CLuster 4 
                    "black", # Cluster 5 
                    "black", # Cluster 6
                    "black", # Cluster 7
                    "black",# Cluster 8
                    "black") # Cluster 9

row_dend_colored = color_branches(row_dend, k = row_k, col = cluster_colors.2)

row_dend_colored = dendextend::set(
  row_dend_colored,
  "branches_lwd",
  5
)


#Clipping z-score

z_clipped <- pmin(pmax(zscore.data.subset, -1), 5)



#Setting color scheme for heatmap
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 5), c( "blue", "white", "red"))

#pdf(file="~/Desktop/cluster_sum_genus_heatmap_all_samples1.pdf", width = 35, height = 32)

all.samples = Heatmap(z_clipped,
        col = col_fun,
        cluster_rows = row_dend_colored,
        row_split = 9,
        cluster_columns = F,
        column_split = factor(genus.padjust.merge$New_sample,
                                           levels = c("OSDS", "US", "TS", "HGW", "LGW_LT", "LGW_HT", "RW", "Honoli'i Stream", "Outfall")),
        name = "Mean Genus z-score", 
        #row_gap = unit(c(1), "mm"), 
        #rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = .5), 
        row_names_side = "left", 
        row_dend_side = "left",   
        row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(z_clipped)), 
        top_annotation = c(cluster_sum_RA),
        border = T, 
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), 
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), 
        width = ncol(z_clipped)*unit(2,"mm"), 
        height = nrow(z_clipped)*unit(3,"mm"),
        show_column_dend = F, 
        row_dend_width = unit( 3, "cm"))

#draw(all.samples)

#dev.off()
```
